title: lesson/1
description: One lesson: a retro entry's class, stated so another project's agent can use it at stage 0. The project retro is canonical; a lesson is its projection (references/iteration.md, The learning loop). scripts/lessons.py builds one from a retro entry that carries a `**Lesson:**` line and refuses anything this schema does not allow. It never carries a transcript, a value, a path outside the repository, a URL, a person's or a customer's name, or code. The origin carries the project's pseudonymous key and the evidence commit: both stay on this machine or estate, and retro.publish strips the whole origin before anything leaves (references/retrospective.md, What may leave the project).

classKey.description: The class as a slug. The identity across projects: two projects with one classKey hold one lesson, seen twice.

title.description: The class in one sentence. States the class, never the incident (redaction rule 5).

check.description: The check that now catches it, by name.

grade.description: The fix grade, 1-3 (references/retrospective.md, Three grades of fix).

stages.description: The stage that owned the failure and the stage that surfaced it. A profile's stage ids need not be numbers.

nouns.description: 3-8 search keys: what stage 0 matches the task's nouns against.

origin.description: Where the lesson was learned. Local and estate only: retro.publish strips it.

project.description: The project's pseudonymous key: `p-` and the first 12 hex digits of the repository's root commit — the first-parent root of its default branch, so every worktree and branch of one repository shares it. Never its name: a repository name can be a customer's or a product's (redaction rule 4). The shared store receives the same key, never a `project:<slug>` id.

commit.description: The evidence commit, which resolves in the project's own clone.

retro.description: The retro file, relative to the repository, and the entry's anchor: the heading's letters and digits in any script, lowercased, every other run one hyphen. The pattern is the script's RETRO_REF, read with Unicode word characters as Python's `re` reads it.

indexEntry.description: One line of the local index (lesson-index/1): one entry per classKey, a pure function of its origins, so a complete rebuild of the same retros with nothing carried and no memory id recorded equals the incremental index byte for byte.

id.description: `L-` and the first 12 hex digits of sha256(classKey).

seen.description: How many origins hold the class, counting re-derived and temporarily unavailable carried origins — not those carried as `checkout holds another project`.

projects.description: How many distinct projects hold it, counted like `seen`: an origin carried as `checkout holds another project` is kept but not counted.

status.description: `candidate` when two or more projects hold it: the retro.publish queue for learned.md.

items.description: Each origin's own lesson fields, its origin, and the shared-store memory id once recorded (`mem:<id>@<revision>`).

memory.description: The shared store's id, `mem:<id>@<revision>` with the revision from 1. One id belongs to one (project, classKey): `record` refuses an id another project's or class's origin holds, and one the loader would refuse.

enum: retro cites a commit that does not resolve
carried.description: Set by `rebuild` on every previous origin it did not re-derive: a rebuild never removes or moves anything on its own, and `rebuild --prune-carried` (optionally `--prune-carried-reason`) is the only way an origin leaves the index. The origin keeps everything recorded on it, its memory id included. `checkout holds another project` — every checkout in the provenance now holds another project key AND the origin's own commit does not resolve there — is kept but not counted in seen/projects/status; every other reason is a temporary unavailability and is counted. `source not read` is the round-7 label, still accepted. Cleared when a checkout holding the origin reads it again.

checkouts.description: Provenance: the real top-level paths of the checkouts this origin was derived from; they decide only the carried reason, never a removal. Local to this machine's index; never emitted to a store, and not printed by `show`.
